scope: Known validation only; no inference; no test accessed.
definition: At confidence0.3, a GT was matched by at least one unchanged baseline, but no prediction overlapping it atIoU>=0.5 survives the hard scale gate before NMS. Thus it cannot become a fusionTP.
quadrantOwnershipLimit: The caches already applied per-tile quadrant ownership. Raw rejected tile boxes are unavailable, so this audit cannot causally attribute a missing tile result to that earlier ownership filter. Seam distance is descriptive only.
